newsitem.title: CHINA: KOREAN FRENCH CLOSES US$70 MLN FRCD.
newsitem.headline: KOREAN FRENCH CLOSES US$70 MLN FRCD.

text.p: Korean French Banking Corp's US$70 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been completed as a club deal, arranger Societe Generale Asia said.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with annual put and call options.
The issue was priced at par to float at 60 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate in year one, 70 basis points in year two and 80 basis points in year three.
Management fees are eight basis points.
Put waiver fees also are eight basis points.

Arrangers are Societe Generale Asia with US$12 million, Bayerische Landesbank Singapore with US$10 million, Sudwest LB Singapore with US$10 million, WestLB Asia Pacific with US$10 million, Banca Commerciale Italiana with US$8 million, DBS Bank with US$7.5 million, KDB International with US$7.5 million, and ING Baring with US$5 million.
